question: Six persons are posing before a camera for a group photograph. P is standing exactly between N and S, while Q is to the immediate left of N. O is at the extreme right, while R is to his immediate left. Who is to the exact right of S?
solution: Total six-person:- O, P, Q, R, S and T 1) P is standing exactly between N and S, while Q is to the immediate left of N.
